description:
Measured at fz-kdt.119's landing (4ca1dc7e7). The review handed this to 'fz-3bb', which is not an issue in this tracker; this is its home.

WHAT WAS MEASURED. fz-kdt.119 gave the tuple axis a sub-predicate per position, so tuple clauses the arity-only test used to collapse are now separate destinations. Corpus executable inventory 4929 -> 4971, and every one of the +42 is on three fixtures:

  receive_map_pattern              11 -> 25
  receive_list_cons_pattern        11 -> 25
  receive_interleaved_tuple_arity  11 -> 25

Each is Kernel.dbg/1 and Kernel.fz_dbg_value/1 going 1 -> 8 specializations. The argument type is a 3-tuple whose positions are each ':unknown | any', the lattice carries that as eight clauses, the test now tells them apart, and eight arms are minted where one stood. 2 functions x 7 x 3 fixtures = 42. Codegen functions moved with them (32 -> 46, 35 -> 49, 35 -> 49 on fz.codegen.define_function).

WHY IT IS WASTE HERE, not precision. dbg/1 does not READ the tuple's positions -- it renders a value. Eight bodies that differ in nothing but a type the body never projects is the over-specialization shape fz-y6w collapsed elsewhere: the separation is real (the test can ask it) but nothing downstream USES it, so the product is paid for nothing. 2^arity is the growth law, so a 4- or 5-position union of the same shape is 16 or 32.

FIX DIRECTION. Two candidates, and they are not exclusive:
(a) do not mint a specialization on a distinction the callee's body never projects -- a demand-side question (which positions does this body read?), which is the fz-y6w dispatch-mask idea one level in;
(b) collapse ':unknown | any' at the source: 'any' already contains ':unknown', so the eight clauses are a union-carved decomposition of ONE type that the lattice keeps apart for carving reasons rather than denotational ones (fz-kdt.48's differently-carved twins, fz-f98.21's widening cure).

Do not 'fix' it by making the tuple test coarser again: the coarse test is the fz-kdt.119 P1.

The three fixtures' budget.codegen.functions headers were re-priced at the landing with this cause recorded in each.
title: A per-position tuple test specializes 2^arity where the callee reads no position
